about: Realistic South African customer sentences for Ubunye, across every shoot group. The deterministic part (matchShootType, plan_outline with fake data) is checked by tests/unit/ubunye-shoot-types.test.ts; scripts/eval/ubunye-live-eval.mjs runs the same set against a deployed preview and scores the replies. Fields: type = expected shoot type slug; first_tool = the tool the model should call first (plan_outline for a multi-part outcome, find_people for one person, search_gear for one piece of gear, none for a plain no); mode = who is shooting it (hire: someone shoots it for them; rent: they shoot it, gear only; produce: people and gear), scored when plan_outline ran, mode_any accepts another honest reading; no_gear_for_hire = in hire mode neither the reply nor the outline may offer crew gear; must_say_any = at least one of these words should appear (lower case) in the reply, e.g. coming soon or not offer; no_unseen_prices = the reply must not quote a rand amount no tool returned.
